hints.title: Common Difference Continuation
hints.text: A sequence of at least three elements is arithmetic if differences between consecutive elements are equal. Extending an arithmetic slice adds multiple new sub-slices.

hints.title: Running Slice Count Invariant
hints.text: If nums[i] continues the difference between previous elements, it contributes curr plus one new arithmetic slices ending at index i.

hints.title: Linear Slice Accumulation Procedure
hints.text: If array length is less than three, return zero. Initialize total and current count to zero. Loop from index 2 to end. If current difference matches previous difference, increment current count and add it to total; otherwise reset current count to zero. Return total.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all O(N^2) subarrays takes O(N^3) time or quadratic time with manual difference verification.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single linear scan tracks the current streak in O(N) time and requires strictly O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize how each consecutive matching element adds 1 + 2 + ... + k slices and optimize space to O(1).
